# forgebase_plan (Data Source)

Looks up an entitlement plan by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forgebase_plan" "pro" {
  key = "pro"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docgen; do not edit by hand (run `go generate ./...`) -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Plan key.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Assignable.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `features` (Attributes List) Features of the plan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))
- `id` (String) The plan key.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Default plan.
- `metadata` (String) Metadata as JSON.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `trial_days` (Number) Trial length.
- `updated_at` (String) Last change.


<a id="nestedatt--features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `features`

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Included.
- `feature` (String) Feature key.
- `limit` (Number) Limit.
- `period` (String) Period.
- `trial_limit` (Number) Trial allowance.
- `unit` (String) Unit.
- `window_secs` (Number) Rolling window.
